business_summary: Yasunaga Corporation manufactures and sells engine parts, thermal components, machine tools, wire saw, and electronics systems in Japan, Thailand, the United States, Indonesia, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company provides automotive/industrial engine parts comprising transportation equipment, construction machinery/agricultural machinery, and leisure products; 5C parts, such as connecting rods, cylinder heads and blocks, camshafts, crankshafts; oil pans, bearing caps, flywheel housing, balance shaft, hydraulic lash adjuster, exhaust manifold, throttle body, and converter housing parts; inverter, transaxle, motor stator and brake actuator housing; and casting parts. It also provides machining equipment, process-specialized equipment, and customized machine tools; wire saw machines; inspection and measuring machines, including semiconductors/electronic components, bare chips, ceramic substrate, green sheet, substrate, sheet, magnetic materials, motor, battery, and customization products, as well as sample test solutions; assembly machines, such as inverter assembly machine, sheet rewinding machine, rubber seal assembling machine, and variable valve timing assembly machine; and environmental equipment comprising air pumps and disposers. The company was formerly known as Yasunaga Tekkosho Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Yasunaga Corporation in April 1988. Yasunaga Corporation was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Iga, Japan.
